convert_ase_dataset: run the ASE dataset conversion script to convert Project Aria scenes to WAI format with RGB, depth, and mask outputs
read_trajectory_file: read a ground truth trajectory CSV file and return device poses and timestamps as numpy arrays
process_sensor: process a single camera sensor by undistorting RGB and range images, converting range to depth, and generating WAI frames
rt_transformation_matrix: compute a 4x4 transformation matrix from a 3x3 rotation matrix and 3D translation vector
get_original_scene_names: get and filter original ASE scene names by checking for render data and scene config files
